record.question: In cold chain process, the walk-in coolers stores vaccine upto:
record.explanation: Answer B: 3 months. Indian vaccine logistics guidance commonly assigns a walk-in cooler to vaccine storage for up to three months at higher-level stores; district/PHC equipment have shorter storage norms. Source/context note: Storage duration depends on level, equipment, stock rotation, and specific operational guideline. Reference: https://mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/Measles%20rubella%20vaccine%20operational%20guidelines.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
